run_NVE_MD_simulation: run an NVE molecular dynamics simulation on atomic structures using VelocityVerlet integrator with LBFGS relaxation
get_thermo_from_log: read a thermo log file and return simulation time and total energy as numpy arrays
load_nve_md_dataset: load MD22 or TM23 dataset structures with their target temperatures from XYZ files
create_NVEMDRunner: create an NVEMDRunner with a calculator, input data, timestep, steps, and save frequency for NVE MD
parse_MD22_TM23_temps: access the MD22_TEMP and TM23_TEMP dictionaries mapping molecules and metals to their simulation temperatures
